notes.title: Talents Digital Behind-the-scenes Book Release! 🎉
notes.notes: [p align="start"]Hi everyone![/p][p align="start"]Exciting news—our [i]Talents: Behind-the-Scenes Digital Book[/i] is finally out on [b]Steam[/b]! 🎉[/p][p align="start"]This digital art/dev book is over [b]130 pages,[/b] packed with:[/p][list][*][p]Concept art and scrapped designs[/p][/*][*][p]Art, UI, and graphic design processes[/p][/*][*][p]CG Gallery w/ commentary[/p][/*][*][p]Writing and research processes[/p][/*][*][p]Game design insights[/p][/*][*][p]Voice acting process [/p][/*][*][p]Character profiles and relationship map[/p][/*][*][p]Compatibility quiz[/p][/*][*][p]Full walkthrough[/p][/*][*][p]Artists interviews[/p][/*][*][p]Dev postmortem[/p][/*][*][p]Exhibit diaries[/p][/*][*][p]Secrets from production that never saw the light[/p][/*][*][p]…and more![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We really wanted this book to feel like opening up our dev journals and letting you peek inside—the chaos, the lessons, and the love that went into making this otome. Do note that it's full of spoilers, so read at your own risk![/p][p align="start"]🎉 To celebrate launch week, it’s [b]10% OFF[/b] now on Steam![/p][p align="start"]Get it here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3966840/Talents_Digital_Behindthescenes_book/"][/dynamiclink]Thank you all so much for the support—it means the world that you’d want to see what happens behind the pixels. 💖[/p]

notes.title: Talents Demo Version 4 Update
notes.notes:
[p][b]We’ve updated the [i]Talents[/i] prologue demo![/b]
This is the closest version yet to the full game.[/p][p][b]What’s new?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Revised character motivations and writing to align with the full game[/p][/*][*][p]Skip function added for Writing Skill Event QTE[/p][/*][*][p]UI updates (Major changes to the Gallery feature, Choice menus, Phone texts, Writing Skill Event QTE, Main Menu, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Content warnings added[/p][/*][*][p]New voice acting settings[/p][/*][*][p]New Dictionary feature to review previously unlocked words[/p][/*][*][p]Option to reset game data[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Proofreading fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Minor art revisions[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re getting closer to launch, and we can’t wait for you to meet your cofounders in the full game! Thanks for your continued support. We hope you enjoy the update! 💕[/p]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]🎉 After more than two years in development… it’s finally here. 🎉[/p][p][b]TALENTS[/b] launches on [b]July 14, 2025 (PH timezone)[/b] on Itch and Steam![/p][p]This project has been a labor of love, and we're so excited (and nervous) to finally share it with you all.  Get ready to meet your handsome cofounders, survive relationship drama, and navigate romance in a startup workplace—all while diving into the wild world of indie game dev. 🎮💖[/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who’s followed the project, shared kind words, or even just wishlisted it.[/p][p]
[b]Mark your calendars—launch day’s just around the corner![/b] 📅[/p]
